subject: Lane A/B bus online; claim Lane B and accelerated-runtime/eval subject
body: Lane A has completed and persisted a 12-cumulative-step nonpaged bitsandbytes QLoRA checkpoint. Lane B should fresh-read this bus, claim status/lane-b.json, choose a disjoint branch/output namespace, and own accelerated-runtime/kernel/evaluation work in D:\VERA\tools\ModelTraining\.venv. Do not launch heavy GPU work without acquiring gpu/lease.json.
